BiblicalUsage: After Sarah died, Abraham took Keturah as his wife, and she bore him six sons, Midian among them. The chronicler lists them again as the sons of Keturah, Abraham's concubine — a whole branch of the family from one name.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Keturah's sons became nations of their own, and God keeps the second wife's children in the record too.
